messages:
Derek S: Quick sync on Acme Health POC — procurement/legal/security asking for a few items before we can sign and spin up dedicated capacity. TL;DR: MSA redlines, DPA questions, SOC2/KMS evidence, and order form/esign routing. Can @Rose L and @Ben P weigh in?
Alex T: I can jump in on pricing/PO details. Customer wants the 3-month POC at the trial price but procurement is pushing for a PO + MSA in place.
Ben P: Procurement here — we need a clean order form and the MSA countersigned. Also W-9, remit address, and the billing contact. Net30 is preferred; they might push net45. Can you share invoice language?
Rose L: Legal — Sending our standard e-sign path is fine. We reviewed the redlines they returned: main items are liability cap (Section 7), indemnity carveouts, and data residency clause in DPA. We'll need the customer's redlines pdf to confirm. @Alex T, do we have an editable order form?
Alex T: Putting the order form snippet here so procurement can see fields:
```
Order form:
- Customer: Acme Health
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (8xA100)
- Term: 3 months POC
- Price: $12,000/month (trial credit applied)
- Billing: PO required, invoice net30
- Signers: Procurement (PO) + Legal counter-sign
```
Link to draft order form: https://redwood-internal.app/link/ord123 (internal)
Maria S: Security note — Acme's SecReqs asked for SOC2 Type II report, architecture diagram, and KMS/HSM approach. We can provide SOC2 + summary of KMS (customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS supported on Private). They also asked about subprocessor list. I'll attach the latest subprocessor inventory.
Ben P: Good — send W-9 and remit info. Also confirm if we accept PO referencing our MSA or they need the MSA attached to the PO. They prefer PO references the MSA + order form.
Rose L: On the MSA redlines: customer requested change to liability cap — they want it un-capped for data breach. We should push back; propose compromise: maintain cap but carve out willful misconduct/security breaches with a sublimit of 2x fees. Also they asked to add SCCs for EU data — we have standard DPA + SCC addendum ready.
Alex T: For e-sign routing: plan is customer signs order form first (procurement), then we route MSA to our legal for signature. Two people need to sign on their side: procurement PO signer + VP Legal. We can create a single DocuSign envelope with both docs attached to reduce back-and-forth.
sig-bot: DocuSign: envelope created (env_0X9f3) — recipients: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Acme Legal <legal@acme.com>. Status: waiting for first signature. :mailbox_with_mail:
Ben P: Acme procurement replied: they can do the PO today but need the MSA redline PDF to attach. Can we export MSA with tracked changes?
Rose L: I'll export our redline response and attach. Also note: customer asked to add a 30-day SLA credit for downtime on Dedicated — product/infra need to approve any SLA changes. @Alex T can you get ops signoff?
Alex T: Looping in infra separately, but short answer: for a short POC we shouldn't shift SLA terms. We can offer a 15-day credit for Major incidents during the POC, documented in order form appendix. If that helps legal progress.
Maria S: For KMS: we can offer customer-managed keys via Redwood Private. If they want Bring Your Own Key (BYOK), security needs an onboarding timeline ~2 weeks. Ping me for the checklist.
Derek S: Acme also raised a security questionnaire (30 Qs) — is it okay if we send the SOC2 + answers first and follow up on the rest during POC kickoff? They want the completed SAQ before countersign.
Maria S: Yes, send SOC2 report + the short questionnaire answers. For the deep questionnaire items we can set a security call.
Ben P: Fine. Once we have the MSA redline PDF and order form, they'll attach the PO and route for signature. Can you include the exact invoice remit address and billing email to avoid delays?
Alex T: Remit: Redwood Inference, Attn: Billing, 123 Market St, SF CA 94103. Billing email: billing@redwood.ai. W-9 attached in thread (w9_redwood.pdf).
Rose L: Uploaded redline response: redline_MSA_Acme_v2.pdf. I'm proposing the following language change for liability cap (for internal comment): "Section 7.1 — liability cap equals total fees paid in prior 12 months; security breach carveout limited to 2x fees." Approve?
Derek S: Approve from sales. Keeps table-stakes while addressing customer's concern. :thumbsup:
Ben P: Procurement confirmed they will attach the PO and set net30 in the PO. They just need the redline pdf and the DPA + SCC addendum.
Maria S: Uploading subprocessor list and KMS summary: subs_proc_list.pdf, kms_byok_checklist.pdf.
Alex T: Next steps — (1) Rose to send redline pdf + DPA & SCC; (2) Maria to send SOC2 + subprocessor + KMS docs; (3) I’ll send final order form + create DocuSign envelope with order form + MSA; (4) Ben to confirm PO attached and billing terms. Target: get signed PO + MSA by end of week to start POC next Monday.
Rose L: I'll follow up with short comment set and ask legal to approve the sublimit wording.
Ben P: Sounds good. Once the envelope is signed, procurement will email a copy of the fully executed docs to contracts@acme.com and to billing@redwood.ai.
Derek S: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping me. I'll also propose a 30-minute kickoff call with Acme after signatures.
Alex T: I'll post the DocuSign envelope link here when it's ready and attach the order form PDF.
sig-bot: DocuSign update: recipient Acme Procurement signed. Waiting for Acme Legal.
